title: StockInfo WebDev DS Project
description: A web application that fetches, analyzes, and visualizes stock market data, providing downloadable reports and real-time insights.
longDescription: StockInfo WebDev DS Project is a dynamic Flask-based web application that allows users to retrieve historical stock data from Yahoo Finance, analyze it using pandas and Sweetviz, generate HTML and PDF reports, download CSVs, and access a RESTful API for stock information. It integrates data science techniques with web development to provide an interactive and user-friendly platform for financial data analysis.
